breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still explicitly instructs to 'replace A(x) with the arithmetic-mean area and treat this as exact in the axial-deformation calculation,' which is the exact error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this instruction entirely and only uses the exact integral. The agent repeated the incorrect instruction rather than eliminating it, even though it also included the correct integral formula.
